ISUN.FluxWarning: A 0 on a magic die has caused a magical flux!
ISUN.CharacterSentence: I am a {foundation} {heart} of the {order} who {forte}
ISUN.SettingArcLimitHint: How many arcs a vislae may pursue at once. The Key suggests three; set 0 to disable the warning.
ISUN.RangeCloseHint: ~10 feet — touch, or within a few steps
ISUN.RangeLongHint: ~100 feet — seen clearly, not reached quickly
ISUN.CurrencyTrueorbHint: Worth a gem orb. A vislae can consume one to gain +1 Hidden Knowledge.
ISUN.CurrencyBloodsilverHint: Worth about a crystal orb, but cursed and widely refused. Ownership alone can trigger the curse.
ISUN.CurrencyVimHint: Drawn on as an action to restore any one Certes pool. Cannot be recharged.
ISUN.CurrencyLuminHint: Drawn on as an action to restore any one Qualia pool. Cannot be recharged.
ISUN.CurrencyDemontearHint: Works like a magecoin but restores any pool. Some fear using them invites demonic influence.
ISUN.MagecoinsHint: Magical goods and services are paid for in magecoins, never in orbs. There is no standard exchange rate between them.
ISUN.BloodsilverRiskHint: Holding more than one bloodsilver coin risks the curse. The GM may call for a Withstand or Resist action between once a week and once a month.
ISUN.ShadowLifeHint: Your exile in Shadow. What you learned there about yourself, not about the world.
ISUN.MemoriesHint: Moments that shaped you, from before or during exile.
ISUN.PersonalityHint: Traits that drive how you act.
ISUN.SecretSoulHint: Visible only to you and the GM. Other players with access to this sheet cannot see it.
ISUN.OrderDegreePlaceholder: e.g. 3rd Degree: Master of the Loom
ISUN.NoOrder: No order assigned. Drag an Order onto this sheet.
ISUN.AggregatesHint: Qualities define what a thread can be woven into; absences define what it cannot.
ISUN.IncantationGrantHint: You meditate, and are given what the universe wants you to have. An acquiescent incantation is not chosen.
ISUN.IncantationChooseHint: A conation incantation is sought rather than granted. You may seek one you have known before, or ask for a general type.
ISUN.ConationCap: It cannot be of a higher level than the highest-level spell you know: {cap}.
ISUN.ConationKnownCount: You have known {count} eligible incantations before.
ISUN.ConationSeekKnownHint: You have held these before. Seeking one back is the only way to name a specific incantation.
ISUN.ConationAskTypeHint: You do not name the incantation, only the kind of thing you need. What answers is not yours to choose — and you will not know whether anything can answer until you ask. The hour is spent either way.
ISUN.ConationNothingOfType: You ask for something {type}, and nothing answers. No such incantation exists within your reach. The hour is spent — {hours} today.
ISUN.ConationNoSpells: You know no spells, so there is no level a conation incantation could be beneath. Learn a spell first.
ISUN.ConationNoneAtLevel: No incantation of level {cap} or lower exists to be sought.
ISUN.IncantationAlsoHeld: {who} already holds {name}. No two vislae working together can hold the same incantation at the same time.
ISUN.IncantationsAllHeld: There is nothing left the universe can give you today — you hold the rest, or received them yesterday.
ISUN.IncantationsDailyCap: You have received {received} incantations today, all your ephemera limit of {cap} allows. No more until the sun rises.
ISUN.IncantationDayNote: Received today: {received} of {cap}. This is your {hours}th hour of meditation.
ISUN.EphemeraFull: No room in your ephemera limit: {used} of {max} held. Incantations count against it alongside ephemera objects.
ISUN.ConationAvailable: Your degree lets {slots} of your ephemera be conation incantations — ones you choose. {used} used.
ISUN.ConationSpentGM: This character has used every conation slot their degree allows. You may still choose for them.
ISUN.ConationNoneGM: This character's degree grants no conation incantations yet. You may still choose for them.
ISUN.Name: Name
ISUN.CapHint: Held against the limit for this character.
ISUN.OverCapHint: Over the limit. Advisory only — secrets and order degrees can raise it, and the GM can override.
ISUN.InjuryTrackHint: Injuries share one track. When it fills, the last injury decides whether the set becomes a Wound or an Anguish.
ISUN.ScourgeHint: Scourge: subtract 1 from your venture for every action drawing on this pool.
ISUN.DeadHint: Three Wounds. The character is dead.
ISUN.BrokenHint: Three Anguish: long-term catatonia, madness, utter suggestibility, or death, as circumstances suggest. The GM decides.
ISUN.ScourgeAllHint: Scourges affecting every pool, such as the debt owed after a Goetic pact.
ISUN.WorstScourgeHint: The heaviest scourge on any one pool. Some effects turn on holding three at once.
ISUN.SoulDrop: Drag a Soul onto the sheet
ISUN.SoulDropReplace: Recorded by name only — drag the Soul item onto the sheet to replace it
ISUN.NoPractices: No spells, incantations, forte abilities or minor magics yet.
ISUN.ChangerySecretsHint: Each requires a change of level 9 or higher, made in a changery, before it works.
ISUN.RestHealHint: Spend a ten-minute or one-hour rest to recover 1 Wound or Anguish.
ISUN.NewDayHint: Sleep: every pool back to its starting value, vexes cleared, rests restored, and 1 Wound recovered.
ISUN.NewDayDone: Rested. Pools reset and the day's rests are restored.
ISUN.NoRestsLeft: No rests left today. Shift-click to reset the pool anyway.
ISUN.NoLongRestsLeft: Healing a Wound or Anguish needs a ten-minute or one-hour rest, and both are spent.
ISUN.VexHint: Vex: spent to subtract 1 from a venture. Refreshing the pool clears any left over.
ISUN.VexAdd: Place a vex in this pool (GM)
ISUN.ApplyDamageHint: Armor comes off physical damage first; what survives becomes Injuries.
ISUN.NegatePrompt: That damage brings a {kind}. Spend 1 bene from {pool} to negate it? ({available} left, and only while the damage is arriving.)
ISUN.SkillRollHint: Roll a venture using this skill
ISUN.SkillVentureHint: What this skill adds to a venture
ISUN.SkillAcumenHint: Acumen cost for each new level in this category
ISUN.VentureTwoSkillsHint: Two skills may both apply when the situation warrants it.
ISUN.PointsToPlaceHint: A stat spends its own points first, then the free ones.
ISUN.StatDerivedHint: The total of this stat's pools
ISUN.FreePointsHint: The 6 your heart leaves free — these may go to either stat.
ISUN.RefreshCosts: Refresh this pool — costs your {rest} rest ({left} left today)
ISUN.PoolValueHint: Bene held now. Click a pip to spend one.
ISUN.PoolMaxHint: What this pool refreshes to — set by placing points.
ISUN.BrowserSearchTextHint: Slower — descriptions have to be loaded for every pack searched.
ISUN.BrowserPacksHint: None selected searches all of them.
ISUN.ApostateHint: Apostates have no degrees. These are what they begin with; the rest are bought at 1 Crux each.
ISUN.TakeAbilityConfirm: Take {name} for {cost} Crux? It also grants {points} points to place in your pools.
ISUN.AbilityTaken: {name} taken for {cost} Crux — {points} points to place.
ISUN.ForteTierHint: How far along the path this ability sits
ISUN.ForteLockedHint: The path to this ability is not open yet
ISUN.FortePickerHint: Take an ability from your forte's tree
ISUN.ForcePickerCrux: {crux} Crux available. Your first ability is free; after that 1 Crux for levels 1–4, 2 for 5–6, 3 for 7 and above.
ISUN.ForteNoneYet: No forte yet — drop one onto the sheet before taking its abilities.
ISUN.AbilityTakenFree: {name} taken — your forte's opening ability, at no cost. {points} points to place.
ISUN.MaxVexHint: A ceiling, not a count. What applies is the lesser of this and what the pool holds, and it cannot be declined.
ISUN.IsDefenceHint: An NPC is acting against the character, who rolls to defend.
ISUN.ChallengeGMOnly: Only the GM declares a challenge.
ISUN.ChallengeNoGM: No GM is connected, so the challenge cannot be answered.
ISUN.RollHint: Rolling spends what you have set aside here.
